rules.action: Exclude advanced training methods unless manually approved.
Do not auto-prescribe; require qualified review.
AI cannot select automatically; manual approval required.
Prefer lower setup complexity and supersets where compatible.
Prefer exercises with easy substitutions and minimal station monopolization.
Prefer fatigue_cost_1_5 <= 3; reduce volume/intensity within programmed bounds.
Cover requested push/pull patterns without unnecessary duplication.
Match movement pattern + primary muscle + goal + difficulty before equipment similarity.
Avoid redundant variants from the same exercise family unless intentionally programmed.
Preserve prescribed values separately from performed values.
